input.circuit_graph: portable node features, directed edges, graph metadata and schema version
input.test_vector_commitment: hash binding the ordered vector schedule
input.validity_mask: valid vectors, cycles, probes and timeout/status fields

output.candidate_nodes: ordered list of portable node references with scores
output.candidate_set_complete: boolean under the frozen catalog and threshold contract
output.confidence: calibrated score plus explicit calibration-scope label
output.evidence: vector/probe groups contributing to the decision without exposing fault identity

unsupported_input_behavior: REJECT WITH SCHEMA OR OOD STATUS; DO NOT SILENTLY COERCE
